design_status: prospectively frozen before batch accuracy/performance or any new optimizer recovery; initial no-fit scalar mean/Jacobian profile allowed after this freeze
scope: Same conditional finite-material Gaussian Green observation model, batched only for exactly affine maps. Preserve declared centre convention, material/holes, arithmetic/near-travel/embedded-rule/tail guards and finite work. No camera or interactive-user-path qualification from kernel timings.

queries.rule: Cartesian product in listed order y-major, unique integer indices. Default base=floor(mapped declared centre); fixed offsets below. Case-specific query_base/offsets override. These are known-geometry operator controls, not truth-derived inverse ROIs.

numerical_controls.refusal_policy: Retain every case/query/status and execution failure. Full-budget eligible controls must resolve with both paths. Projective and near-affine nonzero denominator-gradient cases must use actual scalar fallback and preserve all original result fields exactly. No nonzero projective coefficient is rounded to affine.

materials.D: Exact requested local C/R/f curves, not a world-three-point reconstruction. Hole case subtracts the contained complete circle with supplied role; rectangle controls use exact separable Gaussian CDF products after the declared axis-aligned/reflection map.
materials.positive_area_oracle: Frozen independent conic vertical-slice erfc/GL implementation0537540c; conic/oracle plan inputs pinned. Never call production flux kernel to generate the oracle values. Entire projected disk must stay in one chart for this oracle.

resource_policy: Use identity-isotropic geometry unless stated. No allocation beyond explicit batch memory cap; preserve all requested query entries and None/status semantics under exhaustion. Every fallback is charged against the SAME remaining work budget; report batch-spent and scalar-spent work. Different partitions may reach different unresolved sets under tiny budgets; no false probability or work overspend is accepted. Generous-budget accuracy/status requirements remain unchanged.

derivative_controls.rule: Centered independent-area finite differences at h and h/2 in Cx,Cy,R,f; all56queries. Compare actual boundary-shape Jacobian path(s), not a finite difference of the Green program.
derivative_controls.scope: Numerical derivative validation under fixed H/Sigma/normal, not Fisher calibration. Mean and direct-shape-Jacobian timings stay separate.

timing.cpu_affinity: Pin to min(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) when supported; record original/pinned affinity, CPU/platform/Python/NumPy, environment and load. If unavailable retain correctness but withhold fixed-CPU timing qualification.
timing.concurrency: Sequential paired alternating paths, never concurrent methods or tests in this runner. Root must approve a quiet interval before final timed comparisons; unqualified ambient load remains a limitation.
timing.clock: perf_counter_ns; retain every warmup and timed observation, no fastest-only statistic

initial_scalar_profile.parameters: archived observed seed; input arrays/H/Sigma from frozen V2 row

timing.parameters: Frozen V2 observed seed only, same local samples and global geometry/Hcrop; no re-preparation or rerender.
timing.pair_order: old/new on even repeat, new/old on odd repeat
timing.goals_semantics: Host-bound engineering goals, retained as failed when missed; no numerical/physical criterion is relaxed. Kernel speed alone does not establish optimizer latency or an interactive product path.

later_optimizer_stage.authorization: No optimizer until root reviews this frozen plan and no-fit profile/controls, then final source freeze.
later_optimizer_stage.inputs: Replay the SAME archived24 finite-free-centre cases and12 V2 rows from saved local pixels/values/bounds/normal/H/covariance; no rendering, initializer or field change. Retain original no-fit/upstream/control cases rather than fabricating optimizers.
later_optimizer_stage.frozen_input_metric: Source observations/constants/thresholds already recorded in originals; all original matched/heldout/adverse targets remain unchanged. Original adverse pixel-aperture oracle failure remains explicitly historical and is not repaired by a performance study.
later_optimizer_stage.accuracy: Compare full geometry/levels/cost/heldout values and every completion/ambiguity/work/numeric flag, retaining differences and both outcomes. Matched original targets must remain passed; preexisting adverse target misses/upstream refusals do not become successes by relabeling.
later_optimizer_stage.timed_fit_subset: The three representative V2 40-training datasets above; original vs candidate 1warmup and3 alternating paired timed repeats, same fit settings and input arrays. Record all optimizer/forward/derivative calls/work/panels; no shared thread/process pool.
later_optimizer_stage.fit_settings: Unchanged respective original plans. V2 grid3,iterations24,basins4,evaluations512,forward_work60million,tol1e-8,bounded levels0..255.
later_optimizer_stage.performance_attribution: Profile geometry/mean/directJacobian/linear-face/GP/refinement time separately via wrappers; report actual fitter time and whether mean-only Amdahl ceiling can meet3x. Profiling runs are not mixed into timed repeats.

cli: Required fresh --output NEW_JSON; help/refusal before expensive imports/analysis, no overwrite/dangling symlink. All rows and source before/after closures retained, strict JSON/stdout binding; first actual failure continuation only after root authorizes optimizer stage.
limits: Engineering quadrature/error estimates are not certified Gaussian integrals or physical uncertainty.
Affine dispatch is exact, not a local-Jacobian approximation to a projective map.
No response, optical covariance, wall, pixel aperture, topology or normal calibration is inferred.
No candidate is accepted merely because its performance or local information is good.
All single-thread/CPU timing conclusions remain machine/load dependent.
